zh.title: 中共14機艦台海周邊活動 4架次共機逾越中線
zh.summary: 國防部12日偵獲中共14機艦活動；其中4架次共機逾越台海中線
body: 台灣國防部表示，自2026年8月11日上午6時至12日上午6時止，偵獲共機6架次及共艦8艘持續在台海周邊活動。其中，有4架次共機逾越海峽中線，進入台灣中部及西南空域。對此，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統進行嚴密監控與應處。
根據國防部公布的示意圖，國軍於11日上午8時5分至晚間6時20分，在台海空域偵獲中共3架次輔戰機及直升機，其中1架逾越中線。另於11日上午8時5分至中午12時30分，在海峽中線以東的西南空域偵獲3架次輔戰機。此時正值國軍漢光42號實兵演習第8天。
另據本站統計紀錄，前一日（8月11日）偵獲共機2架次、共艦7艘及公務船6艘。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 14 Chinese Military Vessels and Aircraft Around Strait
en.summary: Taiwan's defense ministry detected 14 Chinese military vessels and aircraft around Taiwan on August 11 and 12
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected 6 Chinese military aircraft and 8 naval vessels operating around Taiwan from 6:00 AM on August 11 to 6:00 AM on August 12, 2026. Among these, 4 aircraft crossed the median line or entered the central and southwestern airspace. Taiwan's military deployed mission aircraft, vessels, and missile systems to monitor the operations.

Specifically, 3 auxiliary aircraft and helicopters were spotted in the Taiwan Strait from 8:05 AM to 6:20 PM on August 11, with 1 crossing the median line. Another 3 auxiliary aircraft were detected in the southwestern airspace east of the median line from 8:05 AM to 12:30 PM. These activities coincided with the eighth day of the Han Kuang 42 military exercise.
According to AVWIRE database statistics, the previous tally on August 11 recorded 2 Chinese aircraft, 7 vessels, and 6 official ships.
